description: Reusable symbolic artifact registry for classifying ServiceNow exam-style question shapes without publishing or storing raw dump content.

artifacts.name: Entity/table name lookup
artifacts.description: Given a ServiceNow entity, class, record type, or concept, ask for its backing table or class name.
artifacts.generationUse: Rotate table/class stems and typed same-family table distractors.

artifacts.name: Role/permission lookup
artifacts.description: Given an action, module, feature, or capability, ask which role grants access or permission.
artifacts.generationUse: Bind verified role facts to scenario stems and adjacent-role distractors.

artifacts.name: Choose valid components
artifacts.description: Ask which options are valid members, components, features, states, or values of a set.
artifacts.generationUse: Use sibling concepts from the same product area as distractors.

artifacts.name: Configuration order/sequence
artifacts.description: Ask first/next/final step or dependency order in a configuration or process flow.
artifacts.generationUse: Rotate process steps while preserving the verified dependency ordering.

artifacts.name: Navigation path lookup
artifacts.description: Ask where to navigate in ServiceNow to reach a module, list, menu, workspace, or UI action.
artifacts.generationUse: Use adjacent application/module paths as distractors.

artifacts.name: Scenario best tool/method
artifacts.description: Given a short scenario, ask for the best ServiceNow tool, method, configuration, or feature.
artifacts.generationUse: Create applied stems that discriminate between similar ServiceNow features.

artifacts.name: Identify invalid option
artifacts.description: NOT/EXCEPT/cannot/invalid-style item asking which option does not belong.
artifacts.generationUse: Generate controlled negative variants from positive set membership facts.

artifacts.name: Concept difference lookup
artifacts.description: Ask for the key difference between two related ServiceNow concepts, records, or features.
artifacts.generationUse: Pair related concepts and rotate difference-focused distractors.

artifacts.name: Relationship lookup
artifacts.description: Ask how two ServiceNow concepts, records, CIs, or process objects relate to each other.
artifacts.generationUse: Bind entity pairs to verified relationship facts.

artifacts.name: Default value lookup
artifacts.description: Ask for a default property, value, state, duration, threshold, or preconfigured behavior.
artifacts.generationUse: Use nearby valid values and adjacent properties as distractors.

artifacts.name: Release feature lookup
artifacts.description: Ask which feature, capability, API, or behavior was added or changed in a named release.
artifacts.generationUse: Drive delta exam coverage from release-note facts.

artifacts.name: Business outcome lookup
artifacts.description: Ask what business outcome, benefit, KPI, or process result a ServiceNow feature supports.
artifacts.generationUse: Create outcome-oriented applied questions tied to source-backed benefits.

artifacts.name: Property behavior lookup
artifacts.description: Ask how a system property, setting, or configuration changes platform behavior.
artifacts.generationUse: Generate property-behavior variants with adjacent-property distractors.
